description: This file contains unit tests for tenantClient utility functions such as normalizeTenantId, fetchSessionTenants, selectTenant, and setActiveTenant. It uses Jest for testing and mocks browser APIs like fetch and localStorage.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant ID formats into a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenant session data from the server and returns an array of tenants.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, updates local storage, and makes a server request to set it as active.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant ID in localStorage and removes legacy keys.
